CM.label: Cameroon
CM.notes: Mobile money dominant; cash backup common in low-connectivity areas.
CM.provider_notes: Live MoMo merchant onboarding is tenant-specific (MTN/Orange APIs). Cash and offline receipts always require staff reconciliation.
CM.operator_ready_label: Corridor defined — connect MTN/Orange merchant APIs; offline receipts still reconcile in-app.
operator_setup_steps: Confirm compliance profile country is Cameroon (CM) and currency XAF.
Register MoMo merchant IDs with MTN and Orange for school payout accounts.
Publish payment codes on invoices and train cashiers on offline receipt capture.
Assign finance staff to review queued receipts against bank statements.
tenant_setup_steps: Confirm compliance profile country is Cameroon (CM) and currency XAF.
Register MoMo merchant IDs with MTN and Orange for school payout accounts.
Publish payment codes on invoices and train cashiers on offline receipt capture.
Assign finance staff to review queued receipts against bank statements.

GH.label: Ghana
GH.notes: MoMo widely used; bank transfer common for fees.
GH.provider_notes: Bank USSD/reference flows vary by institution; Paystack or hub integrations require tenant API keys.
GH.operator_ready_label: Corridor defined — add bank/hub display and optional MoMo integration in tenant settings.
operator_setup_steps: Set Ghana compliance profile (GH / GHS).
Configure displayed bank accounts or hub settlement IDs.
Enable offline receipt capture if campuses may lose connectivity.
Train staff to match references on invoices during reconciliation.
tenant_setup_steps: Set Ghana compliance profile (GH / GHS).
Configure displayed bank accounts or hub settlement IDs.
Enable offline receipt capture if campuses may lose connectivity.
Train staff to match references on invoices during reconciliation.

NG.label: Nigeria
NG.notes: Bank transfer + cards; USSD/mobile-wallet backups vary by tenant.
NG.provider_notes: Paystack/Flutterwave processor contracts and sandbox keys are external onboarding steps.
NG.operator_ready_label: Corridor defined — connect Paystack/Flutterwave and publish bank references on invoices.
operator_setup_steps: Set Nigeria compliance profile (NG / NGN).
Publish bank transfer instructions and invoice references.
Connect supported card processors where entitled.
Route unmatched transfers into receipt upload queue for approval.
tenant_setup_steps: Set Nigeria compliance profile (NG / NGN).
Publish bank transfer instructions and invoice references.
Connect supported card processors where entitled.
Route unmatched transfers into receipt upload queue for approval.

KE.label: Kenya
KE.notes: M-Pesa-style rails often mapped to MTN_MOMO enum where shared.
KE.provider_notes: Dedicated M-Pesa Daraja onboarding is not bundled; map wallet rails via tenant gateway configuration.
KE.operator_ready_label: Corridor defined — map M-Pesa/Daraja or card PSP externally; keep till references consistent.
operator_setup_steps: Set Kenya compliance profile (KE / KES).
Expose till/paybill references consistent with invoice codes.
Allow offline receipts where connectivity fails.
Match statement lines or uploads before approving collections.
tenant_setup_steps: Set Kenya compliance profile (KE / KES).
Expose till/paybill references consistent with invoice codes.
Allow offline receipts where connectivity fails.
Match statement lines or uploads before approving collections.

US.label: United States
US.notes: Card-first; offline receipt capture discouraged except recorded intent for cash.
US.provider_notes: Stripe Connect / ACH onboarding is tenant-owned; platform billing uses separate Stripe accounts.
US.operator_ready_label: Corridor defined — complete Stripe/processor onboarding; ACH/wire as backup.
operator_setup_steps: Set US compliance profile (US / USD).
Complete Stripe or processor onboarding for card-present/card-not-present.
Publish ACH/wire instructions if backup rail active.
Use finance inbox for manual matches when rails dispute.
tenant_setup_steps: Set US compliance profile (US / USD).
Complete Stripe or processor onboarding for card-present/card-not-present.
Publish ACH/wire instructions if backup rail active.
Use finance inbox for manual matches when rails dispute.

GB.label: United Kingdom
GB.notes: FPS/BACS often mapped to BANK rail.
GB.provider_notes: Open Banking aggregators require tenant consent flows with regulated providers.
GB.operator_ready_label: Corridor defined — connect UK card PSP and publish FPS/BACS beneficiary details.
operator_setup_steps: Set UK compliance profile (GB / GBP).
Publish beneficiary details for FPS/BACS.
Enable card processing via Stripe or PSP.
Review uploads against statement references.
tenant_setup_steps: Set UK compliance profile (GB / GBP).
Publish beneficiary details for FPS/BACS.
Enable card processing via Stripe or PSP.
Review uploads against statement references.

EU.label: European Union (SEPA)
EU.notes: Generic EU profile; tenants should set exact country on ComplianceProfile when possible.
EU.provider_notes: SEPA CRED creditor identifiers and mandates are issued per PSP/bank outside this codebase.
EU.operator_ready_label: Corridor defined — obtain SEPA creditor ID and EUR settlement IBAN with your PSP.
operator_setup_steps: Prefer a concrete EU member ISO code on ComplianceProfile when known.
Configure EUR settlement IBAN and creditor identifier.
Enable cards via PSP.
Match SEPA references before closing invoices.
tenant_setup_steps: Prefer a concrete EU member ISO code on ComplianceProfile when known.
Configure EUR settlement IBAN and creditor identifier.
Enable cards via PSP.
